title: The... mall cops?
content: Something we all seem to have in common is, for lack of better terminology, the mall cops: some organized disciplinary force that seems to have some kind of agenda in the mall. To some of us, this force is hostile, to others, it's merely being observed. What are your mallcops like? Have they ever come after your dream self? What did they want? How did you get away? The disciplining force in my mall is more abstract, made of vapor and can go into/out of any being or room to observe and act. I guess like possession. But I always know when it's present and can evade its gaze. So far I don't think it even knows I visit the mall, though I have seen it do scary things to others.
